signals.description: Emitted when the mouse pointer exits all this object's shapes. Requires [member input_ray_pickable] to be [code]true[/code] and at least one [member collision_layer] bit to be set.
signals.name: mouse_exited

classes.brief_description: Base class for all scene objects.

constants.description: Notification received when the node enters a [SceneTree]. See [method _enter_tree].
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_ENTER_TREE

constants.description: Notification received when the node is about to exit a [SceneTree]. See [method _exit_tree].
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_EXIT_TREE

constants.description: Notification received when the node is ready. See [method _ready].
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_READY

constants.description: Notification received when the node is paused. See [member process_mode].
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_PAUSED

constants.description: Notification received when the node is unpaused. See [member process_mode].
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_UNPAUSED

constants.description: Notification received from the tree every physics frame when [method is_physics_processing] returns [code]true[/code]. See [method _physics_process].
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_PHYSICS_PROCESS

constants.description: Notification received from the tree every rendered frame when [method is_processing] returns [code]true[/code]. See [method _process].
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_PROCESS

constants.description: Notification received when the node is set as a child of another node (see [method add_child] and [method add_sibling]).
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_PARENTED

constants.description: Notification received when the parent node calls [method remove_child] on this node.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_UNPARENTED

constants.description: Notification received [i]only[/i] by the newly instantiated scene root node, when [method PackedScene.instantiate] is completed.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_SCENE_INSTANTIATED

constants.description: Notification received when a drag operation begins. All nodes receive this notification, not only the dragged one.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_DRAG_BEGIN

constants.description: Notification received when a drag operation ends.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_DRAG_END

constants.description: Notification received when the node's [member name] or one of its ancestors' [member name] is changed. This notification is [i]not[/i] received when the node is removed from the [SceneTree].
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_PATH_RENAMED

constants.description: Notification received when the list of children is changed. This happens when child nodes are added, moved or removed.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_CHILD_ORDER_CHANGED

constants.description: Notification received from the tree every rendered frame when [method is_processing_internal] returns [code]true[/code].
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_INTERNAL_PROCESS

constants.description: Notification received from the tree every physics frame when [method is_physics_processing_internal] returns [code]true[/code].
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_INTERNAL_PHYSICS_PROCESS

constants.description: Notification received when the node enters the tree, just before [constant NOTIFICATION_READY] may be received. Unlike the latter, it is sent every time the node enters tree, not just once.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_POST_ENTER_TREE

constants.description: Notification received when the node is disabled. See [constant PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED].
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_DISABLED

constants.description: Notification received when the node is enabled again after being disabled. See [constant PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED].
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_ENABLED

constants.description: Notification received when [method reset_physics_interpolation] is called on the node or its ancestors.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_RESET_PHYSICS_INTERPOLATION

constants.description: Notification received right before the scene with the node is saved in the editor. This notification is only sent in the Godot editor and will not occur in exported projects.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_EDITOR_PRE_SAVE

constants.description: Notification received right after the scene with the node is saved in the editor. This notification is only sent in the Godot editor and will not occur in exported projects.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_EDITOR_POST_SAVE

constants.description: Notification received when the mouse enters the window.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_WM_MOUSE_ENTER

constants.description: Notification received when the mouse leaves the window.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_WM_MOUSE_EXIT

constants.description: Notification received from the OS when the node's [Window] ancestor is focused. This may be a change of focus between two windows of the same engine instance, or from the OS desktop or a third-party application to a window of the game (in which case [constant NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_FOCUS_IN] is also received).
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_WM_WINDOW_FOCUS_IN

constants.description: Notification received from the OS when the node's [Window] ancestor is defocused. This may be a change of focus between two windows of the same engine instance, or from a window of the game to the OS desktop or a third-party application (in which case [constant NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_FOCUS_OUT] is also received).
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_WM_WINDOW_FOCUS_OUT

constants.description: Notification received from the OS when a close request is sent (e.g. closing the window with a "Close" button or [kbd]Alt + F4[/kbd]).
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_WM_CLOSE_REQUEST

constants.description: Notification received from the OS when a go back request is sent (e.g. pressing the "Back" button on Android).
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_WM_GO_BACK_REQUEST

constants.description: Notification received when the window is resized.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_WM_SIZE_CHANGED

constants.description: Notification received from the OS when the screen's dots per inch (DPI) scale is changed. Only implemented on macOS.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_WM_DPI_CHANGE

constants.description: Notification received when the mouse cursor enters the [Viewport]'s visible area, that is not occluded behind other [Control]s or [Window]s, provided its [member Viewport.gui_disable_input] is [code]false[/code] and regardless if it's currently focused or not.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_VP_MOUSE_ENTER

constants.description: Notification received when the mouse cursor leaves the [Viewport]'s visible area, that is not occluded behind other [Control]s or [Window]s, provided its [member Viewport.gui_disable_input] is [code]false[/code] and regardless if it's currently focused or not.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_VP_MOUSE_EXIT

constants.description: Notification received when the window is moved.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_WM_POSITION_CHANGED

constants.description: Notification received when the output max linear value returned by [method Window.get_output_max_linear_value] has changed.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_WM_OUTPUT_MAX_LINEAR_VALUE_CHANGED

constants.description: Notification received from the OS when the application is exceeding its allocated memory.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_OS_MEMORY_WARNING

constants.description: Notification received when translations may have changed. Can be triggered by the user changing the locale, changing [member auto_translate_mode] or when the node enters the scene tree. Can be used to respond to language changes, for example to change the UI strings on the fly. Useful when working with the built-in translation support, like [method Object.tr].
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_TRANSLATION_CHANGED

constants.description: Notification received from the OS when a request for "About" information is sent.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_WM_ABOUT

constants.description: Notification received from Godot's crash handler when the engine is about to crash.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_CRASH

constants.description: Notification received from the OS when an update of the Input Method Engine occurs (e.g. change of IME cursor position or composition string).
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_OS_IME_UPDATE

constants.description: Notification received from the OS when the application is resumed.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_RESUMED

constants.description: Notification received from the OS when the application is paused.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_PAUSED

constants.description: Notification received from the OS when the application is focused, i.e. when changing the focus from the OS desktop or a thirdparty application to any open window of the Godot instance.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_FOCUS_IN

constants.description: Notification received from the OS when the application is defocused, i.e. when changing the focus from any open window of the Godot instance to the OS desktop or a thirdparty application.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_FOCUS_OUT

constants.description: Notification received when the [TextServer] is changed.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_TEXT_SERVER_CHANGED

constants.description: Notification received when the application enters picture-in-picture mode.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_PIP_MODE_ENTERED

constants.description: Notification received when the application exits picture-in-picture mode.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_PIP_MODE_EXITED

constants.description: Notification received when an accessibility information update is required.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_ACCESSIBILITY_UPDATE

constants.description: Notification received when accessibility elements are invalidated. All node accessibility elements are automatically deleted after receiving this message, therefore all existing references to such elements should be discarded.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_ACCESSIBILITY_INVALIDATE

classes.description: Nodes are Godot's building blocks. They can be assigned as the child of another node, resulting in a tree arrangement. A given node can contain any number of nodes as children with the requirement that all siblings (direct children of a node) should have unique names.

values.description: Inherits [member process_mode] from the node's parent. This is the default for any newly created node.
values.name: PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT

values.description: Processes when [member SceneTree.paused] is [code]false[/code]. This is the inverse of [constant PROCESS_MODE_WHEN_PAUSED], and the default for the root node.
values.name: PROCESS_MODE_PAUSABLE

values.description: Processes [b]only[/b] when [member SceneTree.paused] is [code]true[/code]. This is the inverse of [constant PROCESS_MODE_PAUSABLE].
values.name: PROCESS_MODE_WHEN_PAUSED

values.description: Always processes. Keeps processing, ignoring [member SceneTree.paused]. This is the inverse of [constant PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED].
values.name: PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS

values.description: Never processes. Completely disables processing, ignoring [member SceneTree.paused]. This is the inverse of [constant PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS].
values.name: PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED

values.description: Process this node based on the thread group mode of the first parent (or grandparent) node that has a thread group mode that is not inherit. See [member process_thread_group] for more information.
values.name: PROCESS_THREAD_GROUP_INHERIT

values.description: Process this node (and child nodes set to inherit) on the main thread. See [member process_thread_group] for more information.
values.name: PROCESS_THREAD_GROUP_MAIN_THREAD

values.description: Process this node (and child nodes set to inherit) on a sub-thread. See [member process_thread_group] for more information.
values.name: PROCESS_THREAD_GROUP_SUB_THREAD

values.description: Allows this node to process threaded messages created with [method call_deferred_thread_group] right before [method _process] is called.
values.name: FLAG_PROCESS_THREAD_MESSAGES

values.description: Allows this node to process threaded messages created with [method call_deferred_thread_group] right before [method _physics_process] is called.
values.name: FLAG_PROCESS_THREAD_MESSAGES_PHYSICS

values.description: Allows this node to process threaded messages created with [method call_deferred_thread_group] right before either [method _process] or [method _physics_process] are called.
values.name: FLAG_PROCESS_THREAD_MESSAGES_ALL

values.description: Inherits [member physics_interpolation_mode] from the node's parent. This is the default for any newly created node.
values.name: PHYSICS_INTERPOLATION_MODE_INHERIT

values.description: Enables physics interpolation for this node and for children set to [constant PHYSICS_INTERPOLATION_MODE_INHERIT]. This is the default for the root node.
values.name: PHYSICS_INTERPOLATION_MODE_ON

values.description: Disables physics interpolation for this node and for children set to [constant PHYSICS_INTERPOLATION_MODE_INHERIT].
values.name: PHYSICS_INTERPOLATION_MODE_OFF

values.description: Duplicate the node's signal connections that are connected with the [constant Object.CONNECT_PERSIST] flag.
values.name: DUPLICATE_SIGNALS

values.description: Duplicate the node's groups.
values.name: DUPLICATE_GROUPS

values.description: Duplicate the node's script (also overriding the duplicated children's scripts, if combined with [constant DUPLICATE_USE_INSTANTIATION]).
values.name: DUPLICATE_SCRIPTS

values.description: Duplicate using [method PackedScene.instantiate]. If the node comes from a scene saved on disk, reuses [method PackedScene.instantiate] as the base for the duplicated node and its children.
values.name: DUPLICATE_USE_INSTANTIATION

values.description: Duplicate also non-serializable variables (i.e. without [constant @GlobalScope.PROPERTY_USAGE_STORAGE]).
values.name: DUPLICATE_INTERNAL_STATE

values.description: Duplicate using default flags. This constant is useful to add or remove a single flag.
values.name: DUPLICATE_DEFAULT

values.description: The node will not be internal.
values.name: INTERNAL_MODE_DISABLED

values.description: The node will be placed at the beginning of the parent's children, before any non-internal sibling.
values.name: INTERNAL_MODE_FRONT

values.description: The node will be placed at the end of the parent's children, after any non-internal sibling.
values.name: INTERNAL_MODE_BACK

values.description: Inherits [member auto_translate_mode] from the node's parent. This is the default for any newly created node.
values.name: AUTO_TRANSLATE_MODE_INHERIT

values.description: Always automatically translate. This is the inverse of [constant AUTO_TRANSLATE_MODE_DISABLED], and the default for the root node.
values.name: AUTO_TRANSLATE_MODE_ALWAYS

values.description: Never automatically translate. This is the inverse of [constant AUTO_TRANSLATE_MODE_ALWAYS].
values.name: AUTO_TRANSLATE_MODE_DISABLED

methods.description: Called on each idle frame, prior to rendering, and after physics ticks have been processed. [param delta] is the time between frames in seconds.
methods.name: _process

methods.description: Called once on each physics tick, and allows Nodes to synchronize their logic with physics ticks. [param delta] is the logical time between physics ticks in seconds and is equal to [member Engine.time_scale] / [member Engine.physics_ticks_per_second].
methods.name: _physics_process

methods.description: Called when the node enters the [SceneTree] (e.g. upon instantiating, scene changing, or after calling [method add_child] in a script). If the node has children, its [method _enter_tree] callback will be called first, and then that of the children.
methods.name: _enter_tree

methods.description: Called when the node is about to leave the [SceneTree] (e.g. upon freeing, scene changing, or after calling [method remove_child] in a script). If the node has children, its [method _exit_tree] callback will be called last, after all its children have left the tree.
methods.name: _exit_tree

methods.description: Called when the node is "ready", i.e. when both the node and its children have entered the scene tree. If the node has children, their [method _ready] callbacks get triggered first, and the parent node will receive the ready notification afterwards.
methods.name: _ready

methods.description: The elements in the array returned from this method are displayed as warnings in the Scene dock if the script that overrides it is a [code]tool[/code] script.
methods.name: _get_configuration_warnings

methods.description: The elements in the array returned from this method are displayed as warnings in the Scene dock if the script that overrides it is a [code]tool[/code] script, and accessibility warnings are enabled in the editor settings.
methods.name: _get_accessibility_configuration_warnings

methods.description: Called when there is an input event. The input event propagates up through the node tree until a node consumes it.
methods.name: _input

methods.description: Called when an [InputEventKey], [InputEventShortcut], or [InputEventJoypadButton] hasn't been consumed by [method _input] or any GUI [Control] item. It is called before [method _unhandled_key_input] and [method _unhandled_input]. The input event propagates up through the node tree until a node consumes it.
methods.name: _shortcut_input

methods.description: Called when an [InputEvent] hasn't been consumed by [method _input] or any GUI [Control] item. It is called after [method _shortcut_input] and after [method _unhandled_key_input]. The input event propagates up through the node tree until a node consumes it.
methods.name: _unhandled_input

methods.description: Called when an [InputEventKey] hasn't been consumed by [method _input] or any GUI [Control] item. It is called after [method _shortcut_input] but before [method _unhandled_input]. The input event propagates up through the node tree until a node consumes it.
methods.name: _unhandled_key_input

methods.description: Called during accessibility information updates to determine the currently focused sub-element, should return a sub-element RID or the value returned by [method get_accessibility_element].
methods.name: _get_focused_accessibility_element

methods.description: Prints all orphan nodes (nodes outside the [SceneTree]). Useful for debugging.
methods.name: print_orphan_nodes

methods.description: Returns object IDs of all orphan nodes (nodes outside the [SceneTree]). Used for debugging.
methods.name: get_orphan_node_ids

methods.description: Adds a [param sibling] node to this node's parent, and moves the added sibling right below this node.
methods.name: add_sibling

methods.description: Adds a child [param node]. Nodes can have any number of children, but every child must have a unique name. Child nodes are automatically deleted when the parent node is deleted, so an entire scene can be removed by deleting its topmost node.
methods.name: add_child

methods.description: Removes a child [param node]. The [param node], along with its children, are [b]not[/b] deleted. To delete a node, see [method queue_free].
methods.name: remove_child

methods.description: Changes the parent of this [Node] to the [param new_parent]. The node needs to already have a parent. The node's [member owner] is preserved if its owner is still reachable from the new location (i.e., the node is still a descendant of the new parent after the operation).
methods.name: reparent

methods.description: Returns the number of children of this node.
methods.name: get_child_count

methods.description: Returns all children of this node inside an [Array].
methods.name: get_children

methods.description: Fetches a child node by its index. Each child node has an index relative to its siblings (see [method get_index]). The first child is at index 0. Negative values can also be used to start from the end of the list. This method can be used in combination with [method get_child_count] to iterate over this node's children. If no child exists at the given index, this method returns [code]null[/code] and an error is generated.
methods.name: get_child

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the [param path] points to a valid node. See also [method get_node].
methods.name: has_node

methods.description: Fetches a node. The [NodePath] can either be a relative path (from this node), or an absolute path (from the [member SceneTree.root]) to a node. If [param path] does not point to a valid node, generates an error and returns [code]null[/code]. Attempts to access methods on the return value will result in an [i]"Attempt to call <method> on a null instance."[/i] error.
methods.name: get_node

methods.description: Fetches a node by [NodePath]. Similar to [method get_node], but does not generate an error if [param path] does not point to a valid node.
methods.name: get_node_or_null

methods.description: Returns this node's parent node, or [code]null[/code] if the node doesn't have a parent.
methods.name: get_parent

methods.description: Finds the first descendant of this node whose [member name] matches [param pattern], returning [code]null[/code] if no match is found. The matching is done against node names, [i]not[/i] their paths, through [method String.match]. As such, it is case-sensitive, [code]"*"[/code] matches zero or more characters, and [code]"?"[/code] matches any single character.
methods.name: find_child

methods.description: Finds all descendants of this node whose names match [param pattern], returning an empty [Array] if no match is found. The matching is done against node names, [i]not[/i] their paths, through [method String.match]. As such, it is case-sensitive, [code]"*"[/code] matches zero or more characters, and [code]"?"[/code] matches any single character.
methods.name: find_children

methods.description: Finds the first ancestor of this node whose [member name] matches [param pattern], returning [code]null[/code] if no match is found. The matching is done through [method String.match]. As such, it is case-sensitive, [code]"*"[/code] matches zero or more characters, and [code]"?"[/code] matches any single character. See also [method find_child] and [method find_children].
methods.name: find_parent

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param path] points to a valid node and its subnames point to a valid [Resource], e.g. [code]Area2D/CollisionShape2D:shape[/code]. Properties that are not [Resource] types (such as nodes or other [Variant] types) are not considered. See also [method get_node_and_resource].
methods.name: has_node_and_resource

methods.description: Fetches a node and its most nested resource as specified by the [NodePath]'s subname. Returns an [Array] of size [code]3[/code] where:
methods.name: get_node_and_resource

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this node is currently inside a [SceneTree]. See also [method get_tree].
methods.name: is_inside_tree

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the node is part of the scene currently opened in the editor.
methods.name: is_part_of_edited_scene

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the given [param node] is a direct or indirect child of this node.
methods.name: is_ancestor_of

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the given [param node] occurs later in the scene hierarchy than this node. A node occurring later is usually processed last.
methods.name: is_greater_than

methods.description: Returns the node's absolute path, relative to the [member SceneTree.root]. If the node is not inside the scene tree, this method fails and returns an empty [NodePath].
methods.name: get_path

methods.description: Returns the relative [NodePath] from this node to the specified [param node]. Both nodes must be in the same [SceneTree] or scene hierarchy, otherwise this method fails and returns an empty [NodePath].
methods.name: get_path_to

methods.description: Adds the node to the [param group]. Groups can be helpful to organize a subset of nodes, for example [code]"enemies"[/code] or [code]"collectables"[/code]. See notes in the description, and the group methods in [SceneTree].
methods.name: add_to_group

methods.description: Removes the node from the given [param group]. Does nothing if the node is not in the [param group]. See also notes in the description, and the [SceneTree]'s group methods.
methods.name: remove_from_group

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this node has been added to the given [param group]. See [method add_to_group] and [method remove_from_group]. See also notes in the description, and the [SceneTree]'s group methods.
methods.name: is_in_group

methods.description: Moves [param child_node] to the given index. A node's index is the order among its siblings. If [param to_index] is negative, the index is counted from the end of the list. See also [method get_child] and [method get_index].
methods.name: move_child

methods.description: Returns an [Array] of group names that the node has been added to.
methods.name: get_groups

methods.description: Returns this node's order among its siblings. The first node's index is [code]0[/code]. See also [method get_child].
methods.name: get_index

methods.description: Prints the node and its children to the console, recursively. The node does not have to be inside the tree. This method outputs [NodePath]s relative to this node, and is good for copy/pasting into [method get_node]. See also [method print_tree_pretty].
methods.name: print_tree

methods.description: Prints the node and its children to the console, recursively. The node does not have to be inside the tree. Similar to [method print_tree], but the graphical representation looks like what is displayed in the editor's Scene dock. It is useful for inspecting larger trees.
methods.name: print_tree_pretty

methods.description: Returns the tree as a [String]. Used mainly for debugging purposes. This version displays the path relative to the current node, and is good for copy/pasting into the [method get_node] function. It also can be used in game UI/UX.
methods.name: get_tree_string

methods.description: Similar to [method get_tree_string], this returns the tree as a [String]. This version displays a more graphical representation similar to what is displayed in the Scene Dock. It is useful for inspecting larger trees.
methods.name: get_tree_string_pretty

methods.description: Calls [method Object.notification] with [param what] on this node and all of its children, recursively.
methods.name: propagate_notification

methods.description: Calls the given [param method] name, passing [param args] as arguments, on this node and all of its children, recursively.
methods.name: propagate_call

methods.description: If set to [code]true[/code], enables physics (fixed framerate) processing. When a node is being processed, it will receive a [constant NOTIFICATION_PHYSICS_PROCESS] at a fixed (usually 60 FPS, see [member Engine.physics_ticks_per_second] to change) interval (and the [method _physics_process] callback will be called if it exists).
methods.name: set_physics_process

methods.description: Returns the time elapsed (in seconds) since the last physics callback. This value is identical to [method _physics_process]'s [code]delta[/code] parameter, and is often consistent at run-time, unless [member Engine.physics_ticks_per_second] is changed. See also [constant NOTIFICATION_PHYSICS_PROCESS].
methods.name: get_physics_process_delta_time

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if physics processing is enabled (see [method set_physics_process]).
methods.name: is_physics_processing

methods.description: Returns the time elapsed (in seconds) since the last process callback. This value is identical to [method _process]'s [code]delta[/code] parameter, and may vary from frame to frame. See also [constant NOTIFICATION_PROCESS].
methods.name: get_process_delta_time

methods.description: If set to [code]true[/code], enables processing. When a node is being processed, it will receive a [constant NOTIFICATION_PROCESS] on every drawn frame (and the [method _process] callback will be called if it exists).
methods.name: set_process

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if processing is enabled (see [method set_process]).
methods.name: is_processing

methods.description: If set to [code]true[/code], enables input processing.
methods.name: set_process_input

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the node is processing input (see [method set_process_input]).
methods.name: is_processing_input

methods.description: If set to [code]true[/code], enables shortcut processing for this node.
methods.name: set_process_shortcut_input

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the node is processing shortcuts (see [method set_process_shortcut_input]).
methods.name: is_processing_shortcut_input

methods.description: If set to [code]true[/code], enables unhandled input processing. It enables the node to receive all input that was not previously handled (usually by a [Control]).
methods.name: set_process_unhandled_input

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the node is processing unhandled input (see [method set_process_unhandled_input]).
methods.name: is_processing_unhandled_input

methods.description: If set to [code]true[/code], enables unhandled key input processing.
methods.name: set_process_unhandled_key_input

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the node is processing unhandled key input (see [method set_process_unhandled_key_input]).
methods.name: is_processing_unhandled_key_input

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the node can receive processing notifications and input callbacks ([constant NOTIFICATION_PROCESS], [method _input], etc.) from the [SceneTree] and [Viewport]. The returned value depends on [member process_mode]:
methods.name: can_process

methods.description: Queues an accessibility information update for this node.
methods.name: queue_accessibility_update

methods.description: Returns main accessibility element RID.
methods.name: get_accessibility_element

methods.description: If set to [code]true[/code], the node appears folded in the Scene dock. As a result, all of its children are hidden. This method is intended to be used in editor plugins and tools, but it also works in release builds. See also [method is_displayed_folded].
methods.name: set_display_folded

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the node is folded (collapsed) in the Scene dock. This method is intended to be used in editor plugins and tools. See also [method set_display_folded].
methods.name: is_displayed_folded

methods.description: If set to [code]true[/code], enables internal processing for this node. Internal processing happens in isolation from the normal [method _process] calls and is used by some nodes internally to guarantee proper functioning even if the node is paused or processing is disabled for scripting ([method set_process]).
methods.name: set_process_internal

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if internal processing is enabled (see [method set_process_internal]).
methods.name: is_processing_internal

methods.description: If set to [code]true[/code], enables internal physics for this node. Internal physics processing happens in isolation from the normal [method _physics_process] calls and is used by some nodes internally to guarantee proper functioning even if the node is paused or physics processing is disabled for scripting ([method set_physics_process]).
methods.name: set_physics_process_internal

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if internal physics processing is enabled (see [method set_physics_process_internal]).
methods.name: is_physics_processing_internal

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if physics interpolation is enabled for this node (see [member physics_interpolation_mode]).
methods.name: is_physics_interpolated

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if physics interpolation is enabled (see [member physics_interpolation_mode]) [b]and[/b] enabled in the [SceneTree].
methods.name: is_physics_interpolated_and_enabled

methods.description: When physics interpolation is active, moving a node to a radically different transform (such as placement within a level) can result in a visible glitch as the object is rendered moving from the old to new position over the physics tick.
methods.name: reset_physics_interpolation

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this node can automatically translate messages depending on the current locale. See [member auto_translate_mode], [method atr], and [method atr_n].
methods.name: can_auto_translate

methods.description: Makes this node inherit the translation domain from its parent node. If this node has no parent, the main translation domain will be used.
methods.name: set_translation_domain_inherited

methods.description: Returns the [Window] that contains this node. If the node is in the main window, this is equivalent to getting the root node ([code]get_tree().get_root()[/code]).
methods.name: get_window

methods.description: Returns the [Window] that contains this node, or the last exclusive child in a chain of windows starting with the one that contains this node.
methods.name: get_last_exclusive_window

methods.description: Returns the [SceneTree] that contains this node. If this node is not inside the tree, generates an error and returns [code]null[/code]. See also [method is_inside_tree].
methods.name: get_tree

methods.description: Creates a new [Tween] and binds it to this node.
methods.name: create_tween

methods.description: Duplicates the node, returning a new node with all of its properties, signals, groups, and children copied from the original, recursively. The behavior can be tweaked through the [param flags] (see [enum DuplicateFlags]). Internal nodes are not duplicated.
methods.name: duplicate

methods.description: Replaces this node by the given [param node]. All children of this node are moved to [param node].
methods.name: replace_by

methods.description: If set to [code]true[/code], the node becomes an [InstancePlaceholder] when packed and instantiated from a [PackedScene]. See also [method get_scene_instance_load_placeholder].
methods.name: set_scene_instance_load_placeholder

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this node is an instance load placeholder. See [InstancePlaceholder] and [method set_scene_instance_load_placeholder].
methods.name: get_scene_instance_load_placeholder

methods.description: Set to [code]true[/code] to allow all nodes owned by [param node] to be available, and editable, in the Scene dock, even if their [member owner] is not the scene root. This method is intended to be used in editor plugins and tools, but it also works in release builds. See also [method is_editable_instance].
methods.name: set_editable_instance

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param node] has editable children enabled relative to this node. This method is intended to be used in editor plugins and tools. See also [method set_editable_instance].
methods.name: is_editable_instance

methods.description: Returns the node's closest [Viewport] ancestor, if the node is inside the tree. Otherwise, returns [code]null[/code].
methods.name: get_viewport

methods.description: Queues this node to be deleted at the end of the current frame. When deleted, all of its children are deleted as well, and all references to the node and its children become invalid.
methods.name: queue_free

methods.description: Requests [method _ready] to be called again the next time the node enters the tree. Does [b]not[/b] immediately call [method _ready].
methods.name: request_ready

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the node is ready, i.e. it's inside scene tree and all its children are initialized.
methods.name: is_node_ready

methods.description: Sets the node's multiplayer authority to the peer with the given peer [param id]. The multiplayer authority is the peer that has authority over the node on the network. Defaults to peer ID 1 (the server). Useful in conjunction with [method rpc_config] and the [MultiplayerAPI].
methods.name: set_multiplayer_authority

methods.description: Returns the peer ID of the multiplayer authority for this node. See [method set_multiplayer_authority].
methods.name: get_multiplayer_authority

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the local system is the multiplayer authority of this node.
methods.name: is_multiplayer_authority

methods.description: Changes the RPC configuration for the given [param method]. [param config] should either be [code]null[/code] to disable the feature (as by default), or a [Dictionary] containing the following entries:
methods.name: rpc_config

methods.description: Returns a [Dictionary] mapping method names to their RPC configuration defined for this node using [method rpc_config].
methods.name: get_node_rpc_config

methods.description: Translates a [param message], using the translation catalogs configured in the Project Settings. Further [param context] can be specified to help with the translation. Note that most [Control] nodes automatically translate their strings, so this method is mostly useful for formatted strings or custom drawn text.
methods.name: atr

methods.description: Translates a [param message] or [param plural_message], using the translation catalogs configured in the Project Settings. Further [param context] can be specified to help with the translation.
methods.name: atr_n

methods.description: Sends a remote procedure call request for the given [param method] to peers on the network (and locally), sending additional arguments to the method called by the RPC. The call request will only be received by nodes with the same [NodePath], including the exact same [member name]. Behavior depends on the RPC configuration for the given [param method] (see [method rpc_config] and [annotation @GDScript.@rpc]). By default, methods are not exposed to RPCs.
methods.name: rpc

methods.description: Sends a [method rpc] to a specific peer identified by [param peer_id] (see [method MultiplayerPeer.set_target_peer]).
methods.name: rpc_id

methods.description: Refreshes the warnings displayed for this node in the Scene dock. Use [method _get_configuration_warnings] to customize the warning messages to display.
methods.name: update_configuration_warnings

methods.description: This function is similar to [method Object.call_deferred] except that the call will take place when the node thread group is processed. If the node thread group processes in sub-threads, then the call will be done on that thread, right before [constant NOTIFICATION_PROCESS] or [constant NOTIFICATION_PHYSICS_PROCESS], the [method _process] or [method _physics_process] or their internal versions are called.
methods.name: call_deferred_thread_group

methods.description: Similar to [method call_deferred_thread_group], but for setting properties.
methods.name: set_deferred_thread_group

methods.description: Similar to [method call_deferred_thread_group], but for notifications.
methods.name: notify_deferred_thread_group

methods.description: This function ensures that the calling of this function will succeed, no matter whether it's being done from a thread or not. If called from a thread that is not allowed to call the function, the call will become deferred. Otherwise, the call will go through directly.
methods.name: call_thread_safe

methods.description: Similar to [method call_thread_safe], but for setting properties.
methods.name: set_thread_safe

methods.description: Similar to [method call_thread_safe], but for notifications.
methods.name: notify_thread_safe

classes.name: Node

properties.description: The name of the node. This name must be unique among the siblings (other child nodes from the same parent). When set to an existing sibling's name, the node is automatically renamed.
properties.name: name

properties.description: If [code]true[/code], the node can be accessed from any node sharing the same [member owner] or from the [member owner] itself, with special [code]%Name[/code] syntax in [method get_node].
properties.name: unique_name_in_owner

properties.description: The original scene's file path, if the node has been instantiated from a [PackedScene] file. Only scene root nodes contains this.
properties.name: scene_file_path

properties.description: The owner of this node. The owner must be an ancestor of this node. When packing the owner node in a [PackedScene], all the nodes it owns are also saved with it. See also [member unique_name_in_owner].
properties.name: owner

properties.description: The [MultiplayerAPI] instance associated with this node. See [method SceneTree.get_multiplayer].
properties.name: multiplayer

properties.description: The node's processing behavior. To check if the node can process in its current mode, use [method can_process].
properties.name: process_mode

properties.description: The node's execution order of the process callbacks ([method _process], [constant NOTIFICATION_PROCESS], and [constant NOTIFICATION_INTERNAL_PROCESS]). Nodes whose priority value is [i]lower[/i] call their process callbacks first, regardless of tree order.
properties.name: process_priority

properties.description: Similar to [member process_priority] but for [constant NOTIFICATION_PHYSICS_PROCESS], [method _physics_process], or [constant NOTIFICATION_INTERNAL_PHYSICS_PROCESS].
properties.name: process_physics_priority

properties.description: Set the process thread group for this node (basically, whether it receives [constant NOTIFICATION_PROCESS], [constant NOTIFICATION_PHYSICS_PROCESS], [method _process] or [method _physics_process] (and the internal versions) on the main thread or in a sub-thread.
properties.name: process_thread_group

properties.description: Change the process thread group order. Groups with a lesser order will process before groups with a greater order. This is useful when a large amount of nodes process in sub thread and, afterwards, another group wants to collect their result in the main thread, as an example.
properties.name: process_thread_group_order

properties.description: Set whether the current thread group will process messages (calls to [method call_deferred_thread_group] on threads), and whether it wants to receive them during regular process or physics process callbacks.
properties.name: process_thread_messages

properties.description: The physics interpolation mode to use for this node. Only effective if [member ProjectSettings.physics/common/physics_interpolation] or [member SceneTree.physics_interpolation] is [code]true[/code].
properties.name: physics_interpolation_mode

properties.description: Defines if any text should automatically change to its translated version depending on the current locale (for nodes such as [Label], [RichTextLabel], [Window], etc.). Also decides if the node's strings should be parsed for translation template generation.
properties.name: auto_translate_mode

properties.description: An optional description to the node. It will be displayed as a tooltip when hovering over the node in the editor's Scene dock.
properties.name: editor_description

signals.description: Emitted when the node is considered ready, after [method _ready] is called.
signals.name: ready

signals.description: Emitted when the node's [member name] is changed, if the node is inside the tree.
signals.name: renamed

signals.description: Emitted when the node enters the tree.
signals.name: tree_entered

signals.description: Emitted when the node is just about to exit the tree. The node is still valid. As such, this is the right place for de-initialization (or a "destructor", if you will).
signals.name: tree_exiting

signals.description: Emitted after the node exits the tree and is no longer active.
signals.name: tree_exited

signals.description: Emitted when the child [param node] enters the [SceneTree], usually because this node entered the tree (see [signal tree_entered]), or [method add_child] has been called.
signals.name: child_entered_tree

signals.description: Emitted when the child [param node] is about to exit the [SceneTree], usually because this node is exiting the tree (see [signal tree_exiting]), or because the child [param node] is being removed or freed.
signals.name: child_exiting_tree

signals.description: Emitted when the list of children is changed. This happens when child nodes are added, moved or removed.
signals.name: child_order_changed

signals.description: Emitted when this node is being replaced by the [param node], see [method replace_by].
signals.name: replacing_by

signals.description: Emitted when the node's editor description field changed.
signals.name: editor_description_changed

signals.description: Emitted when an attribute of the node that is relevant to the editor is changed. Only emitted in the editor.
signals.name: editor_state_changed

classes.brief_description: Base object in 3D space, inherited by all 3D nodes.

constants.description: Notification received when this node's [member global_transform] changes, if [method is_transform_notification_enabled] is [code]true[/code]. See also [method set_notify_transform].
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED

constants.description: Notification received when this node is registered to a new [World3D] (see [method get_world_3d]).
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_ENTER_WORLD

constants.description: Notification received when this node is unregistered from the current [World3D] (see [method get_world_3d]).
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_EXIT_WORLD

constants.description: Notification received when this node's visibility changes (see [member visible] and [method is_visible_in_tree]).
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_VISIBILITY_CHANGED

constants.description: Notification received when this node's [member transform] changes, if [method is_local_transform_notification_enabled] is [code]true[/code]. This is not received when a parent [Node3D]'s [member transform] changes. See also [method set_notify_local_transform].
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_LOCAL_TRANSFORM_CHANGED

classes.description: The [Node3D] node is the base representation of a node in 3D space. All other 3D nodes inherit from this class.

values.description: The rotation is edited using a [Vector3] in [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Euler_angles]Euler angles[/url]. In Godot, Euler angles always use intrinsic order, meaning that rotation happens around the local axes of the object.
values.name: ROTATION_EDIT_MODE_EULER

values.description: The rotation is edited using a [Quaternion]. Quaternions avoid [url=$DOCS_URL/tutorials/3d/using_transforms.html]gimbal lock[/url] and having to choose an order of rotation, but are less intuitive. Quaternion rotation is mostly the same as rotors in 3D geometric algebra, except that the numbers are labeled differently.
values.name: ROTATION_EDIT_MODE_QUATERNION

values.description: The rotation is edited using a [Basis]. In this mode, the raw [member basis]'s axes can be freely modified, but the [member scale] property is not available.
values.name: ROTATION_EDIT_MODE_BASIS

methods.description: When using physics interpolation, there will be circumstances in which you want to know the interpolated (displayed) transform of a node rather than the standard transform (which may only be accurate to the most recent physics tick).
methods.name: get_global_transform_interpolated

methods.description: Returns the parent [Node3D] that directly affects this node's [member global_transform]. Returns [code]null[/code] if no parent exists, the parent is not a [Node3D], or [member top_level] is [code]true[/code].
methods.name: get_parent_node_3d

methods.description: If [code]true[/code], the node will not receive [constant NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED] or [constant NOTIFICATION_LOCAL_TRANSFORM_CHANGED].
methods.name: set_ignore_transform_notification

methods.description: If [code]true[/code], this node's [member global_transform] is automatically orthonormalized. This results in this node not appearing distorted, as if its global scale were set to [constant Vector3.ONE] (or its negative counterpart). See also [method is_scale_disabled] and [method orthonormalize].
methods.name: set_disable_scale

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this node's [member global_transform] is automatically orthonormalized. This results in this node not appearing distorted, as if its global scale were set to [constant Vector3.ONE] (or its negative counterpart). See also [method set_disable_scale] and [method orthonormalize].
methods.name: is_scale_disabled

methods.description: Returns the [World3D] this node is registered to.
methods.name: get_world_3d

methods.description: Forces the node's [member global_transform] to update, by sending [constant NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED]. Fails if the node is not inside the tree.
methods.name: force_update_transform

methods.description: Updates all the [EditorNode3DGizmo] objects attached to this node. Only works in the editor.
methods.name: update_gizmos

methods.description: Attaches the given [param gizmo] to this node. Only works in the editor.
methods.name: add_gizmo

methods.description: Returns all the [EditorNode3DGizmo] objects attached to this node. Only works in the editor.
methods.name: get_gizmos

methods.description: Clears all [EditorNode3DGizmo] objects attached to this node. Only works in the editor.
methods.name: clear_gizmos

methods.description: Selects the [param gizmo]'s subgizmo with the given [param id] and sets its transform. Only works in the editor.
methods.name: set_subgizmo_selection

methods.description: Deselects all subgizmos for this node. Useful to call when the selected subgizmo may no longer exist after a property change. Only works in the editor.
methods.name: clear_subgizmo_selection

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this node is inside the scene tree and the [member visible] property is [code]true[/code] for this node and all of its [Node3D] ancestors [i]in sequence[/i]. An ancestor of any other type (such as [Node] or [Node2D]) breaks the sequence. See also [method Node.get_parent].
methods.name: is_visible_in_tree

methods.description: Allows this node to be rendered. Equivalent to setting [member visible] to [code]true[/code]. This is the opposite of [method hide].
methods.name: show

methods.description: Prevents this node from being rendered. Equivalent to setting [member visible] to [code]false[/code]. This is the opposite of [method show].
methods.name: hide

methods.description: If [code]true[/code], the node will receive [constant NOTIFICATION_LOCAL_TRANSFORM_CHANGED] whenever [member transform] changes.
methods.name: set_notify_local_transform

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the node receives [constant NOTIFICATION_LOCAL_TRANSFORM_CHANGED] whenever [member transform] changes. This is enabled with [method set_notify_local_transform].
methods.name: is_local_transform_notification_enabled

methods.description: If [code]true[/code], the node will receive [constant NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED] whenever [member global_transform] changes.
methods.name: set_notify_transform

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the node receives [constant NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED] whenever [member global_transform] changes. This is enabled with [method set_notify_transform].
methods.name: is_transform_notification_enabled

methods.description: Rotates this node's [member basis] around the [param axis] by the given [param angle], in radians. This operation is calculated in parent space (relative to the parent) and preserves the [member position].
methods.name: rotate

methods.description: Rotates this node's [member global_basis] around the global [param axis] by the given [param angle], in radians. This operation is calculated in global space (relative to the world) and preserves the [member global_position].
methods.name: global_rotate

methods.description: Scales this node's [member global_basis] by the given [param scale] factor. This operation is calculated in global space (relative to the world) and preserves the [member global_position].
methods.name: global_scale

methods.description: Adds the given translation [param offset] to the node's [member global_position] in global space (relative to the world).
methods.name: global_translate

methods.description: Rotates this node's [member basis] around the [param axis] by the given [param angle], in radians. This operation is calculated in local space (relative to this node) and preserves the [member position].
methods.name: rotate_object_local

methods.description: Scales this node's [member basis] by the given [param scale] factor. This operation is calculated in local space (relative to this node) and preserves the [member position].
methods.name: scale_object_local

methods.description: Adds the given translation [param offset] to the node's position, in local space (relative to this node).
methods.name: translate_object_local

methods.description: Rotates this node's [member basis] around the X axis by the given [param angle], in radians. This operation is calculated in parent space (relative to the parent) and preserves the [member position].
methods.name: rotate_x

methods.description: Rotates this node's [member basis] around the Y axis by the given [param angle], in radians. This operation is calculated in parent space (relative to the parent) and preserves the [member position].
methods.name: rotate_y

methods.description: Rotates this node's [member basis] around the Z axis by the given [param angle], in radians. This operation is calculated in parent space (relative to the parent) and preserves the [member position].
methods.name: rotate_z

methods.description: Adds the given translation [param offset] to the node's position, in local space (relative to this node).
methods.name: translate

methods.description: Orthonormalizes this node's [member basis]. This method sets this node's [member scale] to [constant Vector3.ONE] (or its negative counterpart), but preserves the [member position] and [member rotation]. See also [method Transform3D.orthonormalized].
methods.name: orthonormalize

methods.description: Sets this node's [member transform] to [constant Transform3D.IDENTITY], which resets all transformations in parent space ([member position], [member rotation], and [member scale]).
methods.name: set_identity

methods.description: Rotates the node so that the local forward axis (-Z, [constant Vector3.FORWARD]) points toward the [param target] position. This operation is calculated in global space (relative to the world).
methods.name: look_at

methods.description: Moves the node to the specified [param position], then rotates the node to point toward the [param target] position, similar to [method look_at]. This operation is calculated in global space (relative to the world).
methods.name: look_at_from_position

methods.description: Returns the [param global_point] converted from global space to this node's local space. This is the opposite of [method to_global].
methods.name: to_local

methods.description: Returns the [param local_point] converted from this node's local space to global space. This is the opposite of [method to_local].
methods.name: to_global

classes.name: Node3D

properties.description: The local transformation of this node, in parent space (relative to the parent node). Contains and represents this node's [member position], [member rotation], and [member scale].
properties.name: transform

properties.description: The transformation of this node, in global space (relative to the world). Contains and represents this node's [member global_position], [member global_rotation], and global scale.
properties.name: global_transform

properties.description: Position (translation) of this node in parent space (relative to the parent node). This is equivalent to the [member transform]'s [member Transform3D.origin].
properties.name: position

properties.description: Rotation of this node as [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Euler_angles]Euler angles[/url], in radians and in parent space (relative to the parent node). This value is obtained from [member basis]'s rotation.
properties.name: rotation

properties.description: The [member rotation] of this node, in degrees instead of radians.
properties.name: rotation_degrees

properties.description: Rotation of this node represented as a [Quaternion] in parent space (relative to the parent node). This value is obtained from [member basis]'s rotation.
properties.name: quaternion

properties.description: Basis of the [member transform] property. Represents the rotation, scale, and shear of this node in parent space (relative to the parent node).
properties.name: basis

properties.description: Scale of this node in local space (relative to this node). This value is obtained from [member basis]'s scale.
properties.name: scale

properties.description: How this node's rotation and scale are displayed in the Inspector dock.
properties.name: rotation_edit_mode

properties.description: The axis rotation order of the [member rotation] property. In Godot, Euler angles always use intrinsic order, meaning that the final orientation is calculated by rotating around the local axes in this order.
properties.name: rotation_order

properties.description: If [code]true[/code], the node does not inherit its transformations from its parent. As such, node transformations will only be in global space, which also means that [member global_transform] and [member transform] will be identical.
properties.name: top_level

properties.description: Global position (translation) of this node in global space (relative to the world). This is equivalent to the [member global_transform]'s [member Transform3D.origin].
properties.name: global_position

properties.description: Basis of the [member global_transform] property. Represents the rotation, scale, and shear of this node in global space (relative to the world).
properties.name: global_basis

properties.description: Global rotation of this node as [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Euler_angles]Euler angles[/url], in radians and in global space (relative to the world). This value is obtained from [member global_basis]'s rotation.
properties.name: global_rotation

properties.description: The [member global_rotation] of this node, in degrees instead of radians.
properties.name: global_rotation_degrees

properties.description: If [code]true[/code], this node can be visible. The node is only rendered when all of its ancestors are visible, as well. That means [method is_visible_in_tree] must return [code]true[/code].
properties.name: visible

properties.description: Path to the visibility range parent for this node and its descendants. The visibility parent must be a [GeometryInstance3D].
properties.name: visibility_parent

signals.description: Emitted when this node's visibility changes (see [member visible] and [method is_visible_in_tree]).
signals.name: visibility_changed

classes.brief_description: Base class for all other classes in the engine.

constants.description: Notification received when the object is initialized, before its script is attached. Used internally.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_POSTINITIALIZE

constants.description: Notification received when the object is about to be deleted. Can be used like destructors in object-oriented programming languages.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_PREDELETE

constants.description: Notification received when the object finishes hot reloading. This notification is only sent for extensions classes and derived.
constants.name: NOTIFICATION_EXTENSION_RELOADED

classes.description: An advanced [Variant] type. All classes in the engine inherit from Object. Each class may define new properties, methods or signals, which are available to all inheriting classes. For example, a [Sprite2D] instance is able to call [method Node.add_child] because it inherits from [Node].

values.description: Deferred connections trigger their [Callable]s on idle time (at the end of the frame), rather than instantly.
values.name: CONNECT_DEFERRED

values.description: Persisting connections are stored when the object is serialized (such as when using [method PackedScene.pack]). In the editor, connections created through the Signals dock are always persisting.
values.name: CONNECT_PERSIST

values.description: One-shot connections disconnect themselves after emission.
values.name: CONNECT_ONE_SHOT

values.description: Reference-counted connections can be assigned to the same [Callable] multiple times. Each disconnection decreases the internal counter. The signal fully disconnects only when the counter reaches 0.
values.name: CONNECT_REFERENCE_COUNTED

values.description: On signal emission, the source object is automatically appended after the original arguments of the signal, regardless of the connected [Callable]'s unbinds which affect only the original arguments of the signal (see [method Callable.unbind], [method Callable.get_unbound_arguments_count]).
values.name: CONNECT_APPEND_SOURCE_OBJECT

methods.description: Returns the object's built-in class name, as a [String]. See also [method is_class].
methods.name: get_class

methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the object inherits from the given [param class]. See also [method get_class].
methods.name: is_class

methods.description: Assigns [param value] to the given [param property]. If the property does not exist or the given [param value]'s type doesn't match, nothing happens.
methods.name: set

methods.description: Returns the [Variant] value of the given [param property]. If the [param property] does not exist, this method returns [code]null[/code].
methods.name: get

methods.description: Assigns a new [param value] to the property identified by the [param property_path]. The path should be a [NodePath] relative to this object, and can use the colon character ([code]:[/code]) to access nested properties.
methods.name: set_indexed

methods.description: Gets the object's property indexed by the given [param property_path]. The path should be a [NodePath] relative to the current object and can use the colon character ([code]:[/code]) to access nested properties.
methods.name: get_indexed

methods.description: Returns the object's property list as an [Array] of dictionaries. Each [Dictionary] contains the following entries:
methods.name: get_property_list

methods.description: Returns this object's methods and their signatures as an [Array] of dictionaries. Each [Dictionary] contains the following entries:
